extraction.method: manual LLM read of cleaned auto-captions (data/transcripts/n7WpsqsZtdQ.txt), plus targeted video frame sampling (yt-dlp --download-sections + ffmpeg stills) for overlays, card popups, and life totals
caveats: Auto-captions only; no screen overlay data. Card names are garbled and repaired by matching against the published decklists; each repair is flagged.

Life totals and full hand contents are not recoverable from audio.

This is exactly the toolbox-vs-win decision the study wants to learn.
